supported_paths_work_budget_partial.shows: the same in partial: cut max_annotation_work, nothing listed

supported_paths_memory.shows: the memory stops of the supported-path search, with a 1 MB account: six copies of a pattern of 47 supported paths; each listed path's result stays in the account, so the fifth copy's list ends where its paths no longer fit (stop {output, max_memory}, cut max_memory, the counts exact) and the sixth stops in the search at a row the account cannot hold (stop {extension, max_memory}, a rows_refused entry of phase extension, the supported paths at_least, the ones completed before it listed)

supported_paths_require_support.shows: require_support "record_verified": the verified labels only (here every label), limits.require_support echoed

supported_paths_global.shows: coordinates without the record mapping: the best level is label_intersection, every label label_intersection, its occurrence_list the chains (record_bounds_unknown)

supported_paths_primary.shows: a PRIMARY index: one row for a k-mer and its reverse complement, the label level only, orientations instead of strands, note label_intersection_only; the column annotation read without the budget-aware decode (annotation_unbudgeted)

supported_paths_unbudgeted.shows: 400 annotation_unbudgeted: the supported-path search reads the annotation in every mode, and the PRIMARY index's column annotation has no budget-aware decode

supported_paths_support_unavailable.shows: 400 support_unavailable: require_support "record_verified" with supported_paths on an index that cannot verify, in every mode

supported_paths_predicate.shows: a predicate selects among the supported paths (SPEC §20.9): the chimera has no supported path at the record level, so any(562) selects none (tested 0)

supported_paths_predicate_label.shows: the same at the label level: both walks supported by 562 and 573, both selected

supported_paths_predicate_context.shows: none(546), predicate_strands "context": the - walk, whose 7 supporting columns lack 546, is selected; selection_labels [] (none of the predicate's labels is in its support) and labels [] (predicate_only: the predicate's labels on the walk)

supported_paths_predicate_either.shows: the same with "either" (the default): a walk is decided on its support and its reverse-complement walk's, found by the search on the other strand: 546 supports the + walk, which is the - walk's mirror, so none is selected

supported_paths_predicate_mirror.shows: one strand with "either": the mirror walk is looked up (predicate_lookups 1) and its rows read as annotation work (work.mirror_rows, part of annotation_rows; predicate_rows 0); the - walk is selected by its mirror's support (selection_strands ["reverse_complement"]), its own labels [] (546 does not carry it)

supported_paths_predicate_pruned.shows: a monotone predicate (no none, no not) under "context" prunes a branch on whose support it is already false (the - anchor: 546 is not on it): branches_pruned_by_predicate 1, the supported paths at_least 1 (the walks it did not follow are not counted), counts.paths at_least, the selection exact; fewer rows read

supported_paths_predicate_constant.shows: a constant normal form (the typo 5622: false): nothing can be selected, the search counts the supported paths (tested 2), selected exact 0, complete; note predicate_constant

motif_context.shows: predicate_scope "motif" (SPEC §25): "present in 562, absent throughout 546" asked of the pattern as a whole, on the union of its contexts' labels: the 12 - contexts of the blaNDM-1 primer carry 562 and, as deposited, not 546: true, every context tested (an absence claim: labels_absent 1); predicate.motif_scope shard_motif

motif_either.shows: the same with "either": 546 holds the primer on its other strand (the reverse complements' rows), so the motif is false

motif_tested_contexts.shows: a pass the work stopped (max_predicate_work 3000): not every context tested (untested "selection"), but 287 found on the tested ones decides any(287): true, decided_by tested_contexts (a presence claim only; labels_absent null)

motif_long_patterns.shows: the motif of a pattern longer than k is not asked of its walks: NDM-40 (2 anchors) is undecided, untested not_started, while its supported paths are selected; a pattern without anchors has no instance on this graph, so its motif is decided on the empty union (none(562): true, every_context, labels_absent 1)

unknown_field.shows: 400 invalid_request: a field nothing reads is refused, never ignored

too_many_patterns.shows: 400 invalid_request: more patterns than the server's max_patterns (16): a list is refused, never cut

predicate_only_without_predicate.shows: 400 invalid_request: output.labels "predicate_only" returns the labels a predicate names, so it needs one (served with a predicate since increment 5b; 400 later_increment before, fixture later_increment_labels)

later_increment_budget_split.shows: 400 later_increment: budget_split (how a multi-graph request would split its budgets) is refused by name, whatever its value; graphs is served (multi_graph_count)

graphs_single_graph.shows: 400 invalid_request: graphs (a multi-graph server's selection) on a single-graph server, which hosts one graph

in_ram_single_graph.shows: in_ram accepted, as /search's: a single-graph server answers from the index it holds, timing.load_ms 0

multi_graph_count.shows: a multi-graph server answers the graphs a request names (graphs, as /search): one answer per pair, each the single-graph answer tagged with graph, graph_path, annotation_path and index_fp

multi_graph_in_ram.shows: in_ram on a multi-graph server that loaded its graphs into RAM (no --mmap): served from them, timing.load_ms 0; on mmap the pair is loaded for the request and its budget starts after the load

multi_graph_unknown.shows: 400 invalid_request: a name the graph list does not have

representation_unsupported.shows: 400 representation_unsupported: a graph the engine does not recognise (a hash graph), whatever the request asks

deadline_503.shows: HAND-MADE: 503 deadline, the answer could not be written by time_budget_ms (nothing partial is sent)

initializing_503.shows: HAND-MADE: 503 while the index loads (every route; no code; Retry-After: 60)
